description: This Dart file defines the WalletProvider class, which manages wallet-related state and interactions for a Flutter application. It handles balance, income/expense, transaction and category lists, and persists user preferences such as last filter type.

classes.name: WalletProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages wallet state including transactions, categories, balance, and user preferences.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the provider by seeding categories, loading preferences, and refreshing state.

methods.name: _loadPrefs
methods.description: Loads the last used transaction type filter from shared preferences.

methods.name: _saveTypePref
methods.description: Saves the last transaction type filter to shared preferences.

methods.name: setTypeFilter
methods.description: Sets the transaction type filter and persists it, then refreshes state.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Retrieves latest transaction summaries, categories, and updates state.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new wallet transaction and refreshes the data.

methods.name: updateTransaction
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction and refreshes.

methods.name: deleteTransaction
methods.description: Deletes a transaction by ID and refreshes.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Adds a new category and refreshes categories list.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Attempts to delete a category, returns error message if it fails due to in-use constraints.
